_comments: Check-constraint validators pinned in source (bc-aidp-next-golive#298). CodeGen writes each
CHECK constraint's validator into __mj.GeneratedCode and reuses the stored code whenever Source
equals the constraint's current definition, character for character. Without a stored row it
asks the AI again, and the result can differ between runs.
These rows correct what the AI wrote; the generated entity classes are produced from them:
- ActivitySyncExclusion CK_ActivitySyncExclusion_Window: the AI version cast both dates `as any`.
EffectiveFrom / EffectiveTo are already typed Date | null.
- ActivitySyncRunDetail CK_ActivitySyncRunDetail_ContentKey: the AI version treated '' as no
content, but the constraint treats '' as content, so CapturedContent = '' with no key passed
validation and then failed at the database. Both sides are now IS NULL / IS NOT NULL.
CodeGen itself never stores this one: it stores only the first table-level validator per
entity, and ActivitySyncRunDetail has two.
- Activity CK_Activity_External: one regeneration treated '' as missing, the same mismatch as
ContentKey. This is the version next shipped, with next's name. Activity also has two
table-level constraints, so CodeGen never stores this one either.
Every other validator that no migration stores is pinned below too, copied from the generated
entity classes next ships, so a regeneration from migrations reuses all of them and asks the AI
nothing (bizapps-common#238). A PR that adds or changes a CHECK constraint adds or updates its
row here in the same PR, reviewed against the constraint.
Source must stay byte-identical to sys.check_constraints.definition, or CodeGen regenerates.
GeneratedByModelID is required; it names the model that wrote the original.
Push metadata BEFORE the first CodeGen run on a fresh database (mj migrate -> mj sync push
--dir metadata -> mj codegen); otherwise CodeGen stores its own copy first.

fields.Name: ValidateEffectiveToAfterEffectiveFrom
fields.Description: The effective end date must be on or after the effective start date when both dates are provided.
fields.Source: ([EffectiveFrom] IS NULL OR [EffectiveTo] IS NULL OR [EffectiveTo]>=[EffectiveFrom])

fields.Name: ValidateCapturedContentAndEncryptionKeyCoexistence
fields.Description: Captured content and its encryption key must either both be provided or both be empty. This ensures that captured content is always paired with an encryption key, and keys are not stored without content.
fields.Source: ([CapturedContent] IS NULL AND [EncryptionKeyID] IS NULL OR [CapturedContent] IS NOT NULL AND [EncryptionKeyID] IS NOT NULL)

fields.Name: ValidateExternalIdAndSourceSystemCoexistence
fields.Description: Both External ID and Source System must be provided together, or both must be left empty. This ensures that external records are fully identified with both their identifier and their system of origin.
fields.Source: ([ExternalID] IS NULL AND [SourceSystem] IS NULL OR [ExternalID] IS NOT NULL AND [SourceSystem] IS NOT NULL)

fields.Name: ValidateSentimentScoreRange
fields.Description: The sentiment score must be a value between -1.000 and 1.000, or left empty.

fields.Name: ValidateEndedAtAfterStartedAt
fields.Description: The end date and time of an activity must be on or after its start date and time. This ensures that the duration of the activity is chronologically valid.

fields.Name: ValidateEntityOrIdentityExclusivity
fields.Description: The record must be associated with either an Entity and Record ID pair, or an Identity Kind and Identity Value pair. It cannot have both sets of fields populated, nor can it have a partial mix of these fields.
fields.Source: ([EntityID] IS NOT NULL AND [RecordID] IS NOT NULL AND [IdentityKind] IS NULL AND [IdentityValue] IS NULL OR [EntityID] IS NULL AND [RecordID] IS NULL AND [IdentityKind] IS NOT NULL AND [IdentityValue] IS NOT NULL)

fields.Name: ValidateMaxAttachmentBytesGreaterThanZero
fields.Description: The maximum attachment size limit must be a positive value greater than zero, if it is specified.

fields.Name: ValidateEndAtAfterStartAt
fields.Description: If both start and end dates are specified, the end date must be greater than or equal to the start date to ensure logical chronological order.
fields.Source: ([StartAt] IS NULL OR [EndAt] IS NULL OR [EndAt]>=[StartAt])

fields.Name: ValidateTimeoutMSRange
fields.Description: The timeout value must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 300,000 milliseconds (5 minutes) to ensure a valid and reasonable execution limit.

fields.Name: ValidateDefaultMaxAttachmentBytesGreaterThanZero
fields.Description: The default maximum attachment size must be greater than zero if it is specified.

fields.Name: ValidateDefaultEncryptionKeyForSkippedContentPolicy
fields.Description: A default encryption key must be specified unless the default skipped content policy is set to 'None'.

fields.Name: ValidateMaxAttachmentBytesGreaterThanZero
fields.Description: If a maximum attachment size limit is specified, it must be a positive number greater than zero.

fields.Name: ValidateActivitySyncConnectionOrRuleSetRequired
fields.Description: Exactly one of Activity Sync Connection or Activity Sync Rule Set must be specified. You cannot provide both, and you cannot leave both empty.
fields.Source: ([ActivitySyncRuleSetID] IS NULL AND [ActivitySyncConnectionID] IS NOT NULL OR [ActivitySyncRuleSetID] IS NOT NULL AND [ActivitySyncConnectionID] IS NULL)

fields.Name: ValidateDateToAfterOrEqualDateFrom
fields.Description: The end date must be on or after the start date when both dates are provided.
fields.Source: ([DateFrom] IS NULL OR [DateTo] IS NULL OR [DateTo]>=[DateFrom])

fields.Name: ValidateConfidenceRange
fields.Description: Confidence score must be a value between 0 and 1 (inclusive) when specified.

fields.Name: ValidateActivityIDRequiresIncludedDecision
fields.Description: An activity can only be associated with this record if the decision is set to 'Included'.

fields.Name: ValidateWatermarkAfterForDryRun
fields.Description: If the sync is marked as a dry run, a 'Watermark After' date cannot be specified because no progress is actually saved.

fields.Name: ValidateConfidenceRange
fields.Description: Confidence score must be a value between 0.0 and 1.0 (inclusive) if it is provided, representing a valid probability range.
